title: Connected fourth-cumulant domination at the binary Hayes endpoints
statement: Let ell >= 200 and n be 2 ell + 1 or 2 ell + 2. For D_e=N_n(e)-2^(n-ell), M_2=sum_e D_e^2, and M_4=sum_e D_e^4 over invertible classes modulo x^(ell+1), one has 2^ell M_4 - 3 M_2^2 <= M_2^2.

provenance.source: Axeyum gf2-lemire lane; connected convolution-order cumulant and conductor-filtration diagnostics

notes: This is an open aggregate cancellation obligation, not a promoted finite computation. It is equivalent to the root Witt-cylinder ratio R_0<=4 and preserves all signed cancellation across convolution orders. Both endpoint parities satisfy it through ell=23; the exact new ratios at (ell,n)=(22,46),(23,47),(23,48) are approximately 2.999670, 2.994842, and 3.001146. These bounded observations are not evidence for the quantified statement. Combined with the proved second-moment envelope, the conjecture implies M_4<=64 ell^4 2^(3 ell), and the exact implication ledger closes endpoint positivity after the independent finite degree-400 handoff. No Autogenesis operation is registered because no checker can establish the statement universally.
